mostWorthwhile.text: Changing the remembered song by questioning its ending was the strongest moment: it made cultural inheritance and creativity concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating teaching was initially less engaging because its connection to the song was not yet clear.

surprise.text: I liked that teaching produced a new question rather than a final answer, which then became the means of changing the song.

arbitrary.text: The teaching-to-song connection was unclear at first, though the new question eventually gave it a purpose. The compatible options were supplied, so I did not discover that connection independently.

continue.text: Yes. The idea that the world's inhabitants can change what they inherit without my direction makes me curious about what they might create next, although this chapter's largely single-option path offered few meaningful choices.
